capWeight.note: Topstep's Scaling Plan page counts Micro Silver (SIL) as 2 micros, because it is 1/5 of Silver (SI), not 1/10. Its parameters page counts every micro at 10 to a mini, and the other firms' pages don't single SIL out. The app counts SIL as 0.2 of a mini at every firm: the stricter reading, so half as many SIL fit under a mini limit.
